name: sonarcloud-create-project
description: Checks if a project exists in SonarQube Cloud (SonarCloud), creates it if needed and applies its configuration before the analysis.
author: Henry Mosquera

inputs.name: SonarCloud
inputs.label: SonarCloud Service Connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: Select the SonarCloud endpoint for your project. To create one, click on the Manage link and create a new SonarCloud Service Endpoint, then enter your SonarCloud account token.

inputs.name: sonarOrganization
inputs.label: Organization
inputs.helpMarkDown: Select your organization.

inputs.name: serviceKey
inputs.label: Project keyname
inputs.helpMarkDown: Define the key name of the sonar project, e.g.: front-angular. If empty, it is derived as `<organization>_<repository name>` from Build.Repository.Name.

inputs.name: serviceName
inputs.label: Project name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Define the name of the project in sonar, e.g. Front Angular.

inputs.name: createProject
inputs.label: Create project (if it does not exist)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Create project (Yes) | Only check existence (No).

inputs.name: mainBranch
inputs.label: Main Branch Name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Define the main branch name, e.g., trunk or release. (Optional)

inputs.name: visibility
inputs.label: Visibility
inputs.helpMarkDown: Project visibility used when the project is created: private or public.

inputs.name: enforceVisibility
inputs.label: Enforce visibility on existing projects
inputs.helpMarkDown: When checked, the visibility of an already existing project is updated to match the selected one. By default visibility is only applied when the project is created.

inputs.name: tags
inputs.label: Tags
inputs.helpMarkDown: Set comma-separated tags e.g.: dev,back,node.

inputs.name: long_live_branches
inputs.label: Long-lived branches (regex)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Long-lived branches (regex), e.g.: (master|qa). (Optional)

inputs.name: sonarQualityGate
inputs.label: Select the quality gate
inputs.helpMarkDown: Select the quality gate you want to configure in the project. (Optional)

inputs.name: enableNewCodeDefinition
inputs.label: Configure New Code Definition
inputs.helpMarkDown: Check to configure new code definition options. (Optional)

inputs.name: newCodeDefinitionType
inputs.label: New Code Definition Type
inputs.helpMarkDown: Select the new code definition type. (Optional)

inputs.name: newCodeDefinitionValue
inputs.label: New Code Definition Value
inputs.helpMarkDown: Define the value for the new code definition type selected. (Optional)

inputs.name: additionalSettings
inputs.label: Additional settings
inputs.helpMarkDown: One `key=value` per line, e.g. `sonar.exclusions=**/test/**,**/*.spec.ts`. Multi-value settings accept comma-separated values. Lines starting with # are ignored.

inputs.name: qualityProfiles
inputs.label: Quality profiles
inputs.helpMarkDown: One `language=Quality profile name` per line, e.g. `ts=Company way`. Language keys: js, ts, java, cs, py, go, kotlin, php, etc.

inputs.name: permissionTemplate
inputs.label: Permission template
inputs.helpMarkDown: Permission template applied only when the project is created by this task.

inputs.name: groupPermissions
inputs.label: Group permissions
inputs.helpMarkDown: One `group=permission1,permission2` per line. Permissions: admin, codeviewer, issueadmin, securityhotspotadmin, scan, user.

inputs.name: userPermissions
inputs.label: User permissions
inputs.helpMarkDown: One `login=permission1,permission2` per line. Permissions: admin, codeviewer, issueadmin, securityhotspotadmin, scan, user.

inputs.name: dryRun
inputs.label: Dry run
inputs.helpMarkDown: Only log the changes that would be applied, without creating or modifying anything.

inputs.name: failOnConfigError
inputs.label: Fail on configuration errors
inputs.helpMarkDown: When checked, the task fails if any configuration step fails. Otherwise it finishes as 'Succeeded with issues'.

outputVariables.name: SonarProjectUrl
outputVariables.description: URL of the project overview in SonarCloud.

outputVariables.name: SonarProjectExists
outputVariables.description: 'true' if the project existed before the task ran.

outputVariables.name: SonarProjectCreated
outputVariables.description: 'true' if the project was created by this task.
